Open the [bulk reading-status prototype](http://maker:4001/index.html?flow=bulk&control=mode&state=reverse-read). Enter **Select bookmarks**, select the first two cards, open **Reading**, and choose **Mark unread**. Then open **Read later** and confirm both selected bookmarks appear there.

I’ve assumed **Reading** holds both directions explicitly: Mark unread adds the selected bookmarks to Read later, while Mark read removes selected bookmarks from it. Both act on the existing bookmarks rather than creating copies.
